groupEmpty: No hosts in this group yet

groupEditDetail: Hosts of the same group are listed together in the sidebar.
errorGroupExists: A group of that name already exists.
passwordSaveLabel: Save password in the system credential store
passphraseSaveLabel: Save passphrase in the system credential store
hostKeyDetail: The host presented the key below. Make sure it is the one you expect.
hostKeyChangedDetail: The key of {address} is not the one you trusted before. A reinstall can change it; so can someone intercepting the connection.

keyFormatsHint: OpenSSH and PEM private keys are supported.

deleteDetail: Delete {name}? Its saved password or passphrase is removed too.

errorAuthKey: Authentication failed. Check the username and private key.
errorAuthAgent: Authentication failed. Check the keys loaded in the SSH agent.
errorAgent: Could not reach the SSH agent: {error}
errorAgentUnavailable: No SSH agent is running. Start one and load a key with ssh-add.
errorAgentNoKeys: The SSH agent has no keys. Add one with ssh-add.
errorKeyLoad: Could not use the private key: {error}
errorKeyUnlock: Could not unlock the private key. Check the passphrase.
errorHostKey: The host key was not trusted.
setCloseBehaviorDetail: Quit ends sshgo; Keep in Tray lets it run on, its icon opening the window again.
setOpenAtLoginDetail: Start sshgo when you sign in.
setHideAtLoginDetail: Open in the tray instead of showing the window.
setConfirmQuitDetail: Ask before a quit disconnects open sessions.
setAutoConnectDetail: Connect the host selected last when sshgo starts.
quitDetail: {count, plural, one {# session is connected; quitting disconnects it.} other {# sessions are connected; quitting disconnects them.}}
setAutoCheckDetail: Look for updates in the background once a day.
setPrivacyModeDetail: Blur the middle two parts of an IP address in host cards
agentNotConfigured: No model is set up yet. Add a provider and model in Settings → Agent.
agentNoHosts: No hosts yet. Add one in the sidebar first.
agentDeleteDetail: Delete “{title}”? The conversation cannot be recovered.
agentReviewHint: Approve to run on the server
agentBehaviorNote: Each conversation works on one host. The Agent can ask to connect that host when you send, and never asks for a password itself. Conversations are saved in sshgo's data folder.
agentToolsNote: Every call is shown for review, unless read-only actions are allowed below.
setAgentToolsDetail: Let the Agent run commands and read or replace files. Off, it answers from the conversation alone.
setAgentToolShellDetail: Run one non-interactive shell command on the host.
setAgentToolReadFileDetail: Read a UTF-8 text file at an absolute path, up to 128 KiB.
setAgentToolWriteFileDetail: Replace a UTF-8 text file; every write waits for your approval.
setAgentToolListDirDetail: Read directory entries over SFTP, up to 500 at a time.
setAgentToolTerminalDetail: Read the current terminal of the host, screen and scrollback, while it is connected.
setAgentToolMemoryDetail: Read and write notes that later conversations can use; writes always wait for your approval.
setAgentToolWebDetail: Fetch an http or https page or API; every call needs your approval.
setAgentToolAskDetail: Ask with choices, text or secret fields; every question waits for you.
agentAskSecretHint: This answer is not saved in the chat or sent to the model; tools get a handle.
agentToolsOff: The tools switch is off; the Agent will answer from the conversation alone.
agentNoAskNote: Changes, external requests and questions always wait for you; only read-only actions that may run without asking are listed here.
setAgentAutoRunDetail: Run a shell command by itself only when both the model and sshgo's local safety check find it read-only.
setAgentAutoReadToolsDetail: Run tools that only read, such as reading a file, without asking.
setAgentStreamDetail: Turn off to show each reply only when it is complete, so text does not shift as it arrives.
agentHostLocked: This conversation stays on one host.
agentConnectDetail: {name} ({address}) is not connected. Connect before sending?
agentModelsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No models} one {# model} other {# models}}
agentProviderDetail: Keys are stored in the system credential store.
agentProviderDeleteConfirm: Remove “{name}”? Its API key is deleted too.
agentAttachmentTotal: Text attachments can total at most 128 KB.
agentAttachmentImagesTotal: Images can total at most 10 MB.
agentAttachmentUnsupported: Only text files and PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF images are supported: {name}
